scope_constraints.applies_to: Quadratic-chirp finite-difference QFT elimination in H_3(Z_p) and H_3(Z_{2^t})
scope_constraints.controls_included: Includes exact unit concentration in odd-prime H_3(Z_7), exact (1 - 2*Delta/2^t)^2 boundary-cocycle law in dyadic H_3(Z_8) for odd s_1=5 (0.5625 at Delta=1 and 0.0 at Delta=4), unit concentration for even s_1=6, and independent-anchor aliasing.
scope_constraints.does_not_claim: Boundary-free unit QFT concentration in H_3(Z_{2^t}) when s_1 is odd and Delta > 0, or dechirping across independent unmeasured anchors y_{0,1} != y_{0,2}
